invariants.title: Money is integer cents; each line's tax is what the invoice charged, never recomputed.
Tax due is tax charged on invoices in the period less the tax inside credits raised in it; a write-off gives none back.
Recording a filing is a person's act, with a reason, refused to an agent whatever its role.
A filing keeps the return as it stood; a later change shows as changed since and is named on the next return.
A filed amount that differs needs a reason; an unfinished period cannot be filed; filed periods never overlap.
Payments are recorded, never made, never exceed what is owed, and wait in the bank reconciliation.
Sales Tax Payable equals tax charged less tax given back less payments; a difference is named.
Every write is a logged command with an actor; refusals are logged too.
